in_sanskrit.name: Mahebub
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Wine
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mahebub एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mahebub is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘māheshvara’, which means ‘the god of intoxication’. Mahebub is a name of Lord Shiva, who is also known as the god of wine and is often depicted holding a drink or a cup of wine in his hand.
